quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on his decision-making process for attacking the basket
quotes.excerpt: I was trying to make the home run play.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Obviously you've been able to get to the basket, saw it even more again tonight. How are you reading situations where it's the time to attack, the time to try to make a play? Is it coming far more simplified for you, or do you still feel like there's some areas where you can put the turnovers in but you were trying to make a play on those?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: With the turnovers, I was trying to make the home run play. Overall, I feel like scoring is something that I've done so far my whole career, so I'm not really too much worried about that part. I'm worried about trying to make the right pass, getting two feet in the paint, and letting the play develop in front of me.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green says he is focusing on making the right pass and letting the play develop rather than trying to force the home run play when attacking the basket.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on the team's developing rotation and chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I don't care who's out there, you know they're going to come out and play hard.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How are you seeing the rotation right now? It looks like a nine or ten is pretty much set when you count Luke and then also coming back. How are you liking that or how have you sensed that developed throughout preseason?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I think it's great. I think we have a good group of guys already. We've been in the lab together a lot already, so I don't care who's out there, you know they're going to come out and play hard and we're going to hoop.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green likes the current rotation and chemistry developing in the preseason, noting that the group has put in the work together in the lab.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on the team's offensive pace and unselfishness
quotes.excerpt: Our stops and getting stops and getting out and running is going to be a big part.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What excites you most about just what you all have and what you're working with already in terms of your offense, the way all of your pieces are kind of complementing each other?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I think just the pace of the game. Our stops and getting stops and getting out and running is going to be a big part of why we win games. Playing fast, skip passes, finding the open man, that's going to play a big part just moving the ball, sharing the rock. We got a lot of unselfish guys and then there's a lot of playmakers and a lot of scorers on the team.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green believes the team's ability to play fast, get stops, and share the ball will be the key to winning games this season.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on the team's defensive communication and chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I think we already are very good at communicating to each other, talking.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: I was going to ask you about the defense, just the communication part. It feels like y'all are very much on the string the way you're getting into the gaps and everything. Is there a genuine level of comfort that you have with the other guys that are in that main rotation just off of knowing where each other is and how you can kind of operate based off of that?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I would say so. I think we already are very good at communicating to each other, talking. Just us being on the string, that come from just us having that chemistry already, being in the lab all summer. Obviously when you do things like that, we're able to communicate and know what we're trying to do out there.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green credits the team's defensive communication and chemistry to the time spent working together in the lab throughout the summer.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on team's progress heading into the regular season
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we're already established like how we going to play.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Whether for you personally or for just you guys as a unit, do you feel that you accomplished everything that you wanted to in the preseason heading into the season opener on Wednesday?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: As a group, I would say yeah. I feel like we're already established like how we going to play and stuff like that. Obviously there's areas that can improve and that's always going to be the case, you're going to improve always, but overall yes. Let's just keep it simple, not dig into it too much.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green feels the team is well-prepared for the regular season opener and has established a clear identity on how they want to play.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on his defensive focus and help-side awareness
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I've always been able to guard on ball.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Jalen, your all-ball defense has been great in these games. Was that something you were focusing on coming into the year, or is this just a high level we're seeing from you before the real show gets underway? Do you feel like you and Booker are underrated in that regard in terms of a matchup like tonight that you two can more than handle your own with that defensively?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I feel like I've always been able to guard on ball. I think the defensive thing comes from help-side, low man, being engaged. I think on ball, I feel like I've always been able to guard, so I think so. Obviously not smaller guards, but as a guard, you're going to get that regardless if you could guard, so I feel like I've done a good job over these past three, four years.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green says he has always been capable of guarding on the ball and is now focused on being more engaged as a help-side defender.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on developing chemistry with Miles Bridges
quotes.excerpt: I think he contributes to that a lot.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Jalen, saw Miles do a little bit of everything today. They got the shot going a little bit, was active defensively on the boards. How has it been playing next to him and what are you excited about continuing to grow and develop that partnership on the court with Miles?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I mean he brings this is another offensive, defensive presence out there. You know he can hit the mid-range, shoot the three, get to the cup, run in transition, and I think that's going to be super big for us. Like I said to you, playing fast is going to be a reason, a big reason of winning games for us, and I think he contributes to that a lot.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green highlights the versatility Miles Bridges brings to the court, noting his ability to score at all three levels and contribute in transition.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on his evolution as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I've had the ball in my hands my whole career.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Jalen, you've played alongside a lot of table-setting point guards, VanVleet, Kevin Porter Jr., and now you're kind of turning into one, I want to say, with your ability to just sort of set up the offense. What's that evolution process been like for you?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: Obviously it's been different, you know. Coming to the league, all you are set out to do is just, you know, score. I'm mixing in here and there just setting up the offense, but I feel like I've had the ball in my hands my whole career, including high school and so forth and so on, all the way into the NBA. So it's not no different from that aspect. It's just the slowing down process, you know, not going one speed all the time and I feel like that's been a main thing of my game, so the slowing down process and not looking for my shot right away in the beginning of the offense, the flow.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green on his evolution as a playmaker: The main thing has been the slowing down process and not looking for my shot right away in the beginning of the offense.
